notes.title: Update – Bug Fixes!
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! 

Thank you for reporting - with your help we could find and fix a few important bugs. 
💲 Doubled implant prices got fixed, so no more extra charges for weapons
🏆 Achievement are working fine again.
Update the game and let us know if you're still getting any issues. 
If you're unable to download the game on Mac/Linux getting 0 bytes size - that's a known issue that occurs on these systems. 

It's usually caused by certain incompatibilities - we're currently looking into what we can do about it. 
Also, let us know in case you still get UI issues, like being unable to close the tutorial - this issue seems to be fixed on most screen sizes and ratios.

Huge thanks for your help! Update and dive back in - we’re always listening. 💘

notes.title: Update – Balance Tweaks, Bug Fixes & More!
notes.notes:
We’ve been reading through all the feedback, and an update to fix the existing issues is ready now! The patch is focused around combat balance, performance improvements and fixing the annoying bugs - we've tried to smooth out the experience as much as we could.
A quick summary:
⚔ We've rebalanced the combat system, making it a little bit harder and interesting yet still fair and engaging
🐞 We've found and fixed a lot of bugs (i.e. bugs that occur when starting the new game after completing it once) - thanks to 
everyone for quick reports! 
💻 We've worked on screen adaptivity - no more unclickable buttons, stretched out backgrounds and similar issues. 
🔨We've improved game's overall stability and performance. 
Big thanks to everyone for reporting issues and cooperating - your help in bringing this update to life is unquestionable.

Update the game and jump in! Let us know in case you still face any issues - we're listening closely. 💘
